rubric_items.reason: All 18 known REQs are traced by at least one story; no assumed or unknown REQs exist.
Stories are mostly single-outcome; S-4 bundles placement, privacy and page exclusivity, and S-3 bundles counts with the warning.
ACs are Given/When/Then and mostly discriminating (already-started, Cancelled, No-show, threshold 1 vs 2), but both time-zone ACs use the default zone, so a hard-coded Asia/Kolkata passes.
Threshold 2, empty-state texts and UTC+05:30 come from the intent or are derived inline; other values are example data, not limits.
Readable with consistent terms; body ACs for S-2 to S-5 are abbreviated and drop the Given/When/Then form used in the front matter.

findings.text: S-1 AC5 and S-2 AC3 set useSettings().timeZone to Asia/Kolkata, the default. The likeliest wrong implementation, a hard-coded Asia/Kolkata, passes both, though REQ-9 and A-01 forbid hard-coding the zone.

cites.quote: Given useSettings().timeZone is Asia/Kolkata (UTC+05:30) and the next Scheduled appointment starts at 19:00 UTC on 9 March
Given useSettings().timeZone is Asia/Kolkata (UTC+05:30) and the latest Completed appointment started at 20:00 UTC on 9 March

findings.suggested_fix: Add an AC per display where useSettings().timeZone is set to a non-default zone and the UTC instant falls on a different date or time there than in Asia/Kolkata, with the expected value derived inline.

findings.text: S-4 AC3 tests only phone and email for REQ-16, but the patient row also holds address and emergency_contact_phone; an implementation that leaks those would pass.

cites.quote: then the Visits summary shows neither the phone number nor the email

findings.suggested_fix: Extend S-4 AC3 to a patient with address and emergency contact phone recorded and assert none of the contact fields appear.

findings.text: S-4 AC2 seeds only allergies and current medications; blood group, chronic conditions and notes, also medical history per the glossary, are not exercised.

cites.quote: Given a patient with allergies and current medications recorded
Blood group, allergies, chronic conditions, current medications and notes of one patient.

findings.suggested_fix: Seed all five medical history fields in S-4 AC2.

findings.text: Body ACs for S-2 to S-5 are shortened and drop the When step or the Given/When/Then form, so the body and front matter word the same ACs differently.

cites.quote: - AC2: exactly one No-show → count 1, not highlighted.
- AC1: the Visits summary is below the patient's name and above the details.

findings.suggested_fix: Render the body ACs with the same Given/When/Then text as the front matter.
